title: Wanderer and Enchanted Realm
description: A black and white line art illustration with purple accents shows a lone hiker with backpack and staff standing on a purple flower-covered hillside. A winding path leads toward a large transparent sphere containing five floating faces, set before a dark mountain range where a couple embraces at the peak. To the right stands an ornate castle with a coiled dragon perched on its tower, all beneath a starry night sky with constellations.
